description: The Rescue Team is on standby when it starts receiving reports of strange phenomenon taking place around the globe. At first, wacky weather patterns seem to the worst of the planet's worries, but then strange robotic creatures begin to emerge from oceans and caverns and spark catastrophic calamities!  Known as Power Eaters, the robot forces unleash unimaginable power surges wherever they appear! As the leader of the Rescue Team, you will use your courageous crew to investigate their origin and shut them down before they turn Earth into a huge ball of lightning!
